## TC-001-P :: Homepage loads with visible book catalogue
- **Type**: Positive
- **Priority**: High
- **Preconditions**: Network access to http://books.toscrape.com
- **Test Data**: URL = `http://books.toscrape.com`
- **Steps**: 1. Navigate to homepage 2. Assert response status is 200 3. Assert at least one `article.product_pod` is visible
- **Expected Result**: Page loads with HTTP 200 and at least one book item visible
- **Linked FR**: FR-01
- **Fault Type**: n/a
